about.title: About Proland
about.subtitle: Transforming real estate in Tanzania through transparency, verified listings, and direct buyer-owner connection.
about.mission_desc: To eliminate real estate scams, hidden fees, and unreliable brokers by providing a 100% verified digital platform for property buyers, tenants, and property owners.
about.vision_desc: To become East Africa's standard infrastructure for property ownership, leasing, and verified real estate transactions.

about_page.hero_body: Proland is building the trust layer that Tanzanian real estate has always needed.
about_page.our_story_p1: Property searching in Tanzania has a trust problem. Buyers routinely encounter listings that don't exist at the posted price, agents who collect "viewing fees" and disappear, and owners who receive low-quality inquiries from people who never intended to pay. The complaints are consistent across every major platform — and they stem from the same root cause: no one is verifying anything before it goes live.
about_page.our_story_p1_strong: no one is verifying anything before it goes live.
about_page.our_story_p2: Proland was built to fix that. Before any listing appears on our platform, a member of our admin team reviews it — confirming the property exists, the price is real, and the owner is legitimate. It takes longer than a self-serve classifieds upload, and that's the point: every listing that clears our queue is one fewer scam for a buyer to navigate.
about_page.our_story_p3: We also built the booking side from scratch: request a site visit, see the property in person, then confirm payment. In that order. Never the other way around.
about_page.why1_desc: Every property is reviewed and approved by our admin team before it goes public — no ghost listings, no scams.
about_page.why2_desc: You book a site visit, inspect the property, and only pay once you're satisfied. We never ask you to pay sight unseen.
about_page.why3_desc: Chat directly with the verified property owner via WhatsApp — no middleman charging a commission on the conversation.
